verdict.rationale: Penpot's own documented self-hosting lets users decide where their data lives: private cloud, on-premise, or any environment they control, deployed via docker compose or Kubernetes/Helm. Community users confirm running self-hosted instances. Residency control therefore comes only through self-deployment; nothing shows region or residency selection on Penpot's hosted cloud. Missing for 10: region/residency choice for the hosted SaaS instance, documented data-residency guarantees or region list, and independent corroboration of residency-specific controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Choose where and how to host it, and decide who has access to it.
Run it in your private cloud, on-premise, or any environment you control.
Deploy the official Helm Chart, Deploy in Openshift, Deploy in Rancher
You can self-deploy or use their free instance.
